title: CCP2 rollout and radio qualification
description: Deliver the accepted receiver-aware CCP policy through exact wire contracts, independent oracles, Python/Rust/C production integration, joined conformance tests and evidence-based documentation. Include separately gated full-band US915, narrow-band amateur and microfragment/LR-FHSS feasibility work; these experiments do not alter baseline SCHC or activate unqualified RF modes. This is the revision-specific execution branch of existing CCP epic project-LICHEN-kudc, not a replacement for existing helper/gap work.
acceptance_criteria: Core rollout complete only after all three production paths and shared conformance gates pass. Deployment/experimental claims require their distinct RF and authorization evidence. Preserve legacy fixtures, upstream Yggdrasil identity, best-effort custody, human-only OSCORE edit boundary and three independent reviews for code changes.
